About us
Technology and AI do not have to be complicated.

Taurus Technology was founded on that one simple principle. We focus on building strong, enduring partnerships with our clients: we take the time to understand your pain points, then find simple, affordable solutions to them.

We spent years working with large organizations, implementing expensive, complex solutions that were often over-engineered. Our focus now is deliberately scaled back. We work with smaller businesses to identify and execute quick wins: the initiatives that take low effort to implement but deliver a high return on investment.

Michael Shanley
Founder & CEO

Michael spent years leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives and technology implementations for large organizations before founding Taurus Technology to bring that same discipline, without the complexity or the price tag, to smaller businesses. He leads every assessment and working session personally, and he measures success the same way you do: hours back, dollars back, better work out the door.
